newsitem.title: USA: Florida Muni Power Agency pulls refunding deal.
newsitem.headline: Florida Muni Power Agency pulls refunding deal.

text.p: The Florida Municipal Power Agency scrapped a $57.2 million revenue refunding bond issue Wednesday because of deteriorating market conditions, the agency's financial adviser said.
"Present value savings thresholds were not met due to a deteriorating market," said financial adviser Clinton Dunlap of Dunlap and Associates.
Goldman Sachs & Co submitted the winning bid for the competitive deal with a true interest cost of 5.4473 percent, Dunlap said.
That would have achieved a present value savings of about 2.38 percent, and the agency was seeking at least 3 percent, he said.
Dunlap said the deal would be attempted again "whenever the market changes."
